artworks.title: Figure Bending Forward with Right Knee Raised
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John W. Simpson
artworks.description: The image shows a side view sketch of a person in a bent-over position with one knee raised. The person's arms are bent at the elbows, with hands near the chest. Facial features are simple, and the hair is short or pulled back. The person is nude, and the background is plain beige with no other details.

artworks.title: Figure Facing Forward
artworks.medium: graphite and watercolor on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John W. Simpson
artworks.description: This painting is a sketch of a human figure in motion. The person stands, facing us, with one foot in front of the other and their arms outstretched. Their hand on the left curves downward, while their hand on the right curves up in an impossible position. Their head is turned down and to the left, and they look downward with a neutral expression. They appear to have some kind of cloth around their head, or some sort of hat with a long feather. On their left side are several curving gray lines, perhaps indicating movement or shadow. Their body has been painted in light brown, and the background is plain paper.

artworks.title: Rear View of Female Figure in Action
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John W. Simpson
artworks.description: This painting shows a nude person standing with their back to us. They are drawn with simple lines, one hand on their hip and the other hand raised next to their head. Their legs are close together, with their feet crossed at the ankles. The person's brown hair is styled in a bun or pulled over one shoulder. The person's skin is mostly painted with a light peachy tone, but there are areas of dark, irregular spots that have the impression of discoloration. The background is plain beige paper. In the bottom right corner, there is handwritten text.

artworks.title: Dancing Figure
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John W. Simpson
artworks.description: A woman stands balanced on one foot and reaches overhead and holds the other foot with at least one arm in this vertical drawing on now-yellowed paper. The person is outlined in graphite and filled in loosely with a peach color. The head is sketched as a round circle with a few sweeping lines suggesting tendrils of hair. Graphite writing in the lower right corner reads, “homage a Madame K. Simpson A. Rodin 11 octobre 1905.”

artworks.title: Two Figures
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John W. Simpson
artworks.description: This painting shows two nude people depicted from head to toe. One person stands, supporting the other, who seems to be leaning backwards with one of their feet raised from the ground. The leaning person has their back to us, and the standing person has their head bent down so we don't see their face. They both have pale peach skin and brown hair, and their bodies are drawn with simple gray lines without much detail. The background is beige paper, with a few faint, wavy lines by the feet of the people.

artworks.title: Seated Female Nude Leaning to the Left
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (folded sh): 31.2 x 20 cm (12 5/16 x 7 7/8 in.)
overall (unfolded): 31.2 x 40 cm (12 5/16 x 15 3/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John W. Simpson
artworks.description: This is a pencil drawing of a nude woman who appears to be sitting with her knees crossed. The woman’s head is tilted backward with her chin slightly raised, one arm bent at the elbow with her hand below her chin. Her facial features are lightly sketched, focusing on the outline of her nose and eyes, and her hair appears short. The background is plain, beige paper, and in the bottom right corner there are a few lines of handwriting.

artworks.title: Seated Female Nude Looking Forward
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (folded sh): 31.2 x 20 cm (12 5/16 x 7 7/8 in.)
overall (unfolded): 31.2 x 40 cm (12 5/16 x 15 3/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John W. Simpson
artworks.description: This sketch depicts the full figure of a person standing, with one arm bent upwards above the head and the other resting near the thigh. The facial features are abstract, with forward-facing eyes and a neutral expression. The hair is indicated with loosely curved lines. The figure is not wearing any clothing, but details of the human form are suggested. In the lower left corner, handwritten text appears. The paper background is plain, emphasizing the fluid lines of the drawing.

artworks.title: Les Amours Conduisant le Monde (Love Turning the World)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John W. Simpson
artworks.description: The image depicts swirling lines and curved shapes against a textured background. A circular form is central to the composition, with cherubic figures appearing to support and play around it. The figures have small, chubby limbs and exhibit playful innocence. Some figures are climbing or hanging onto the circular form. The backdrop and line style suggest clouds or celestial elements, enhancing the abstract quality of the scene.

artworks.title: Buste de Bellone
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John W. Simpson
artworks.description: The image portrays an illustration of a person from the chest up, turned slightly to the viewer's left. The person is wearing a helmet with a crest, and long, wavy hair flows out from underneath. The facial features are detailed with a pronounced nose and deep-set eyes, conveying a serious expression. The clothing suggests armor or draped cloth. The background is a plain canvas with no additional objects. On the right side, there is a handwritten inscription in cursive script.

artworks.title: Victor Hugo, De Trois Quarts
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John W. Simpson
artworks.description: This print appear to show two portraits focusing on the head and shoulders of an older man, shown in profile, facing the right. The portrait on top is detailed and realistic, while the one on the bottom is much more sketch-like. The man has a pronounced forehead, a long nose, high cheekbones, deep-set eyes, and a full, bushy beard. His hair is combed back and appears thinning on top, with strands falling around his ears. He is wearing a collared garment. In the top sketch, he has a neutral expression, while in the bottom sketch his brow is slightly furrowed, making him look angrier. The background is plain, beige paper with some stray marks and lines on it.

artworks.title: Les Petites Chaumières (Thatched Cottages--Small Plate)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint and drypoint on parchment
artworks.description: The image shows a rural landscape with a path and a group of geese on the left side. In the middle of the scene, there is a traditional house with chimneys emitting smoke. The etching technique is used, featuring fine lines and shading. The color palette is monochrome, using sepia and gray tones. In the background, there are darker silhouettes of buildings and vegetation under a sky with swirling clouds.

artworks.title: Les Voisins de Campagne (Country Neighbors)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, and drypoint in black on vellum
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene with two figures walking in the rain, one holding an umbrella over themselves and a child. A small dog walks beside them. In the background is a house with trees lining the path leading to it, beyond a wrought-iron fence. The scene is rendered in a monochromatic palette of sepia and charcoal, with detailed, cross-hatched brushstrokes creating a textured and dynamic atmosphere. The composition is framed by decorative elements on the border.

artworks.title: Kneeling in an Armchair
artworks.description: The image shows a young girl sitting or leaning with one arm on the back of a chair or sofa. She is angled slightly to the side, with her head turned towards the viewer. The girl has a serene expression on her face and medium-length, wavy hair. She appears to be wearing a light fabric garment, perhaps a nightgown or dress, loosely draped over her shoulders. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background is plain, with subtle lines indicating a wall or drapery texture. The focus is on the girl's posture, light, and shadows.

artworks.title: The Caress
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of two figures: a woman and a baby. The woman is depicted from the waist up, sitting sideways, holding the baby on her lap. The woman has gentle facial features with a calm expression and her hair styled in a bun. The baby has short hair and soft features, also with a peaceful expression. Both figures are dressed in simple garments. The background is a plain surface with vertical lines.

artworks.title: The Mirror
artworks.description: There is an etching of a woman and a child. The woman is seated with the child on her lap. She has a neat bun, a dark dress, and the child has straight hair and light-colored clothing. They are reflected in a mirror behind them, showing the room and a chair back.

artworks.title: Maternal Caress
artworks.medium: color drypoint, softground etching, and aquatint on wove paper
artworks.description: We look slightly down onto a young woman sitting in an upholstered chair and tightly hugging a nude, blond child in this vertical, colored print. Both have pale, peach-toned skin. The woman’s black hair is pulled back though a couple tendrils curl on her forehead. Her eyes are downcast and her pink lips parted. She wears a long, cream-white dress dotted with blush-pink, petal-like forms. One arm is under the baby’s chubby bottom and the other braces the child behind the shoulders. The baby wraps their arms around the woman’s neck so they are cheek to cheek. The chair sits in front of a bed with a boxy frame and a pillowy white mattress. The upholstery on the woman’s chair and the wallpaper behind her are patterned with dusky rose-pink flowers and vines against butter yellow. The floor is coral orange. The artist signed the print in graphite under the lower right corner, “Mary Cassatt.”

artworks.title: Combe Bottom
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape from a slightly elevated point of view with dense foliage of trees and bushes covering most of the upper part. The artwork uses an etching technique with detailed and cross-hatched lines creating texture and depth. Two hares are depicted in the lower right section. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and gray. Light and shadow play across the rough terrain, suggesting a setting at either dawn or dusk.

artworks.title: Challow Farm
artworks.description: The image is an etching showing a rural landscape from an eye-level perspective. The horizon is in the middle, obscured by dense foliage. To the left are trees and a cottage, and a donkey stands in the center. The sketch-like style features defined lines showing tree and foliage details. The monochrome color palette creates contrast for visual depth and texture in the landscape.

artworks.title: An Early Riser
artworks.description: The image shows a misty landscape with an elevated perspective. The horizon is visible near the top, with a soft glow of light suggesting the presence of the sun. In the scene, rocky terrain is covered in mist with a stag silhouetted against the light. The painting technique features soft brushstrokes creating an ethereal quality. The color scheme is muted, mainly sepia tones, and the mist obscures finer details, adding to the mysterious and tranquil mood of the scene.

artworks.title: Kensington Gardens (The Larger Plate)
artworks.description: The image depicts a dense forest with tall trees dominating the scene. The viewpoint is low, looking up towards the treetops. The print uses an etching technique to show detailed lines of branches and leaves, creating a textured, naturalistic appearance. The color scheme is monochromatic, with shades of black and off-white creating contrast between sunlit areas and shadowy parts. The foreground shows large tree trunks extending into a canopy, while in the background, the forest gradually becomes more diffuse with no visible background beyond.

artworks.title: Early Morning - Richmond
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a path winding through a wooded area. The horizon is visible towards the left, where the land meets the sky, partially obscured by foliage. The style features fine line work depicting texture and detail in trees and vegetation. The color scheme is monochromatic, with various shades of black and grey on a beige background. Tall trees on the right create depth, with detailed trunks and branches, contrasting with a softer depiction of the distant landscape on the left.

artworks.title: Mytton Hall
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a pathway leading to a building entrance. There are trees and foliage framing a stone archway at the center. Two spherical stone ornaments are on the ground. The perspective is slightly angled and the scene is enveloped by shadows and trees. The etching has fine lines creating textures and shading. The color palette is sepia, giving an antique feel. Shadows and light areas contribute to the visual impact of the scene.

artworks.title: Shere Mill Pond (The Larger Plate)
artworks.description: The image shows a calm, narrow river winding through a densely forested landscape. The brushstrokes display meticulous cross-hatching, adding detail and texture to the scene. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing the light and dark tones. Reeds, tall grass, and a bird in flight are visible near the water's edge. In the distance, thick clusters of trees with some structures and tall poplar trees are silhouetted against a light sky.
